data.long_meaning: The name Neharika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘neha’ which means new or fresh. This name is often given to a baby girl born in the new year or during the spring season. The name Neharika carries the meaning “New, Fresh” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neharika usually hope their child will grow to embody new, fresh and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Neha, meaning new, encourages an individual to continually seek new experiences, learn new things, and expand their horizons.
